scope: All multiple-choice catalog questions, options, and rationale in Hebrew and English.

method.generated_review: Read every distinct paired prose/option/rationale wording. Only numerical substitutions were deduplicated; different wording was retained. All generated cases then passed structural and oracle checks.
method.preserved_review: Read all 40 legacy draft and 50 pilot records, including all localized choices and rationale.
method.professional_review: AI copy and bilingual equivalence review; no human professional attestation.
